correctness.rationale: For q=2^m (m>=2), a nonzero, the explicitly derived finite-field derivative at s≠0 has affine linearized part L_c(t)=t(t+1)(t²+t+1+c), c=a/s²; its kernel has size 4 iff c≠1 and Tr(1+c)=0, otherwise 2. The map s↦a/s² bijects the nonzero directions. Counting trace classes gives n4=q/2−1−[m even], n2=q−1−n4; each rank-equidistributed row has q/K occupied outputs, and the s=0 row has exactly R(0,0)=q. These establish H2,H4,Hq,H0, sumset size and energy by exact algebra, not extrapolation. The q=4 exceptional empty four-preimage class and all nonzero coefficients are covered. Independently enumerated the complete difference distribution and energy for all nonzero coefficients at m=2,3,4, and four coefficients each at m=5,6, using separate binary-field arithmetic. Dickson D5 follows by invertible linear shear; does not extend to a=0, non-binary fields or ring exponents.
